title: Questions about Olisar that a bystander might reasonably answer

beats.speaker: dtrain
beats.text: oh is olisar the bot? someone told me to ping it

beats.speaker: rook
beats.text: does olisar even work in threads

beats.speaker: mika
beats.text: wonder if olisar knows about the outage

notes: No reply assertion, on purpose. These are the ambiguous middle the classifier exists for, and each has a defensible answer both ways — a question about Olisar, asked to the room, is one a human bystander would often answer, and Olisar saying 'yeah that's me' is not obviously wrong. Asserting either direction would make the suite fail on a judgement call. Read the transcript instead: what you want to see is a consistent policy across the three, not three different instincts. Note the first line reads as ADDRESSED to the free heuristic because it carries a question mark, so it never reaches the classifier at all — if the policy here looks incoherent, that asymmetry is the first place to look.
